context:
Goal: the question-box check clears finished tasks.
Problem (rule): the session board never sees the Stop event that lists background tasks, on every surface, not only in cloud. Getting around it would weaken an org security default.
Based on (read): the CLI puts the built-in security plugin first for any Team or Enterprise organization, on every surface where mods load: terminal, desktop and cloud (its README, "Where it is seated"; the same text is in the installed program). Your Compass account is such an organization.
Based on (assumed): it holds on your desktop and terminal too; no run there has shown it, so this is read from the code, not measured.
Departs from: main (a session-board Stop handler that never runs) — the handler is removed and its limit recorded.

options.gain: The docs say what really happens, everywhere.
options.how: Remove the handler, record the limit as the decision-watch mod does, and fix the README.
options.label: Delete the dead handler and record the limit
options.lose: A missed task notice can block the question box for the rest of the session.

options.how: The mod clears a finished task when it sees a task stop or a later tool call.
options.label: Also clear on task stop or tool calls
options.lose: More code, and still a gap.

options.how: File a request so the turn-complete event carries the background task list.
options.label: Ask Anthropic for the task list on turn complete
